findings.diagnosis: PAY, 'Accept card payments', places BANK, the unfamiliar bank API integration, after UI and COPY. BANK depends on an external team and has no de-risking spike, so integration surprises would arrive after the earlier work, leaving less time to adjust the payment plan.
findings.recommended_action: Propose moving BANK earlier or adding a small integration spike before committing to its full scope, respecting human-curated sequencing.
